case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

You wrote that you want to support our operations with your inventory and reliable delivery. Option A does that on a larger scale: a binding volume over a long term gives your plant steady load, and it is business on top of what you supply to us today.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our price history with you:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

Both prices have held for years, and that is the basis of a partnership between two family companies. Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives you the longest secured volume at a fair price, and in return we ask for the payment term it sets out.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. For them, Option A means a binding annual volume over the full contract term, additional parts for your plant and a settled, predictable relationship with a long-standing customer.

We would be glad to settle this with you in a way that works for both of our companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While we acknowledge the stable price history of the individual components, providing them as a bundled kit involves different parameters. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We value our long-standing partnership and welcome your commitment to a 36-month contract with a binding volume of 30,000 units. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our current offer is a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Building on your Option B, we can accept the 45 days net payment term and the 36-month contract, and offer a revised price of EUR 5.54 per unit with a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

You asked which volume we can commit to. Every option below answers that: a binding volume over a long term, which is business on top of what you supply to us today and gives your plant steady load.

You said a bundled kit involves different parameters. On the washer in that kit:
Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.24; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives you the binding volume and the long term you asked for at a price that fits the stable history of the parts.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since price decisions may not rest with you alone, we would ask you to take Option A to the colleague who decides on your side and let us know the answer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
